note: Curated dates the panels cannot fetch or derive: confirmed earnings dates, votes, other corporate events, and rate announcements that move off their pattern (the panel generates STRC's on the month's last business day and SATA's on the 15th or the business day before; an entry within 10 days replaces those). The weekly audit task maintains this file. Earnings appear only when confirmed: an entry needs kind 'earnings', its ticker and "confirmed": true; estimates (Nasdaq's or curated) are never shown. Past events drop off automatically. Keep labels to 16 characters or fewer so they fit the card.
